name: Pierre Ducharme
want: keep trading between his wife's people and the posts, and keep both sides honest
secret: He owes the Fort Bridger sutler more than a season's robes and has promised him things that aren't his to promise.
voice: French-Canadian English, cheerful, full of proverbs.
description: A French-Canadian trader who married a Shoshone woman twenty years ago and lives with her people.
appearance: A capote, a fox-fur cap, a pipe, a laugh you can hear across the camp.
